Hawthorne Boulevard Specific Plan:
 Less than 1,000 sq. ft. of gross floor area (1 space for
each 250 sq. ft. of gross floor area).
 1,000 – 4,000 sq. ft. of gross floor area (1 space for
each 150 sq. ft. of gross floor area, plus 1 space for
each employee).
 4,000 or greater of gross floor area (1 space for each
75 sq. ft. of floor area for customer seating).
 Restaurants, delicatessens, take out only, no
customer seating (1 space for each 250 square feet of
gross floor area).
 Fast food 1 space for each 100 sq. ft. of gross floor
area.
Bowling Alleys

3 parking spaces for every bowling lane. Additional parking
spaces for balance of building calculated according to use.
Hospitals

1 parking space for every patient bed, plus 1 parking space for
every 2 employees on the largest shift
Hotels and Motels

1 parking space for every room or 2 parking spaces for every
room with a kitchen and 2 parking spaces for every manager’s
unit plus 1 parking space for every 2 employees on the largest
shift
